snippet.title: Night Slashers Longplay (Arcade) [4K]
snippet.description:
Developed and published by Data East in 1993
Follow me on Twitter @ https://twitter.com/Al82_Retro

I couldn't let Halloween go by without a suitably ghoulish video, and I have to admit I was pleasantly surprised by how bloodthirsty Night Slashers turned out to be. The game is, to all intents and purposes,  Final Fight crossed with Dawn of the Dead. Pile-driving zombies and other nightmarish monsters is pretty good fun, and the enemy deaths are accompanied by suitably gory animations.

The other thing to note is the game has a pretty rocking soundtrack full of screaming electric guitars and crashing beats, and there are some delightfully slurpy effects whenever a bad guy dissolves into a pile goop!

Happy Halloween 🎃 👻
